## Round-3 residuals & VS Code muscle-memory

Since **0.1.20** (`f736efd`) / unreleased probe fixes on `main`:

### Keybindings & discoverability
- **Fold / Unfold** on Linux: Ctrl+Shift+[ / ] (and `{` / `}` spellings) keep working; chords are **global** so the command palette paints the tip
- **Toggle Terminal** Ctrl+`: palette shows the chord (same global-binding path as sidebar / preview)
- **Palette key hints complete** for Fold, Unfold, Toggle Terminal, word wrap, line comment, and other palette rows that have bindings
- **Ctrl+B** = file sidebar; **Bold** = Ctrl+Shift+B (from 0.1.20 probe)
- **Ctrl+Shift+V** toggles editor|preview ↔ editor-only
- **Quit** with dirty buffers: Save / Don't save / Cancel confirm (no silent quit)

### Terminal
- Kill control stays labeled with a usable hit target
- **No dual composer** while a PTY session is alive — type into the shell prompt; `$ Run a command…` only appears to start a shell after exit/Kill

### Zoom
- Status bar zoom % is **relative to default = 100%** on a clean settings file
- Foreign/non-Malgel `settings.json` fragments no longer adopt a stranger's `font_size` (which showed as ~80% on cold open)

### Also since 0.1.20
- Larger fold-column hit feel and character (not byte) selection count in 0.1.20 notes still apply
